operations.name: The Petting Zoo Job
operations.blurb: A municipal petting zoo with one bored attendant and a gate latch a determined toddler has already defeated twice.
operations.success: You leave a polite note and an entirely fictional receipt.
operations.failure: The attendant was not bored. The attendant was WAITING. You leave without incident and without livestock.
news: Petting zoo reports one (1) goat unaccounted for. Attendant describes suspect as "determined".
Petting zoo down one exhibit. Staff describe the gate as "technically still a gate".
Petting zoo announces a temporary closure and a permanent change of policy.
Petting zoo inventory is short. The children saw nothing and are lying.
Petting zoo reports a goat-shaped absence. No further detail offered.
Petting zoo installs a taller fence. The fence is not the issue and they know it.
Petting zoo staff report "an orderly departure" by something that should not be orderly.

operations.name: Feed Co-op Skim
operations.blurb: The agricultural co-op weighs everything twice and records it once. There is a margin in that, and the margin is yours.
operations.success: The books balance. They balance beautifully. They balance towards you.
operations.failure: The co-op has hired an accountant with a suspicious mind and a calculator with a receipt roll.
news: Agricultural co-op announces "routine" audit. Announcement is described by staff as "not routine".
Feed co-op reports a discrepancy of several tonnes and a shrug.
Feed co-op's stocktake does not balance. It is being balanced by other means.
Agricultural co-op tightens security on a barn that no longer contains anything.
Feed co-op notes an unusual volume of night deliveries, outbound.
Agricultural co-op declines to comment on the weighbridge. At length.

operations.name: The Grant Application
operations.blurb: A regional innovation fund with a generous budget and, crucially, no biologists on the review panel. This one is entirely legal. Mostly legal. It is a grey area and you are wearing a lab coat.
operations.success: Funded. The panel particularly admired the diagrams, which were of a goat.
operations.failure: Rejected. The panel had, it turns out, exactly one biologist, and she has questions.
news: Regional innovation fund backs local agritech venture. Fund declines to specify which agri, or indeed which tech.
Innovation grant awarded. The application's diagrams were called "ambitious".
Regional fund disburses to an applicant it is now trying to locate.
Grant approved on the strength of a phrase nobody on the panel understood.
Innovation fund reports a successful placement and a mild headache.
Regional fund's quarterly report includes one line item and no photograph.

operations.name: County Fair Livestock Tent
operations.blurb: Prize animals, rosettes, and a security cordon made entirely of bunting. Something large and confident could simply walk out with a winner.
operations.success: You take the Grand Champion and, out of pure spite, its rosette.
operations.failure: The tent collapses. Everyone is fine. Nobody is impressed.
operations.news: County fair cancels livestock judging. Grand Champion "reassigned to private research," says nobody official.

operations.name: The Aquarium Night Shift
operations.blurb: Twelve tanks, one night watchman, and a service corridor that floods on purpose. Something that swims would find this easy. Something that does not can still get wet and try.
operations.success: Nothing was harmed. Several things were RELOCATED, at speed, in a cooler.
operations.failure: The service corridor flooded on purpose and you were in it. You have been asked not to return.
operations.news: Municipal aquarium down one exhibit. Staff insist the tank lid was "definitely on".

operations.name: Aviary Skylight
operations.blurb: A domed aviary with a skylight that opens for ventilation and closes on a timer nobody has serviced since the nineties.
operations.success: In and out through the roof. The birds seemed to approve, which was unsettling.
operations.failure: The skylight timer chose tonight, of all nights, to work perfectly.
operations.news: Aviary reports skylight fault and one absent raptor. Ornithologists "deeply concerned and quietly impressed".

operations.name: The Reptile House
operations.blurb: Heated glass, thick gloves, and a keeper who counts the enclosures twice a night. Nothing in here wants to be carried, which is the whole difficulty.
operations.success: Everything is accounted for except the things you took, which are accounted for by you.
operations.failure: The keeper counted twice. The keeper always counts twice. You knew this.
operations.news: Reptile house locks down after inventory discrepancy. Keeper: "I counted. I always count."
